senses.sense_definition: The philosophical theory or principle that an entity or system is greater than the simple sum of its parts.

examples.text: The philosopher argued that <w>holism</w> provides a better framework for understanding ecosystems.
Unlike strict reductionism, <w>holism</w> emphasizes the complex connections within the entire system.

senses.sense_definition: A practice, method, or approach based on the belief that whole systems should be viewed interconnectedly rather than broken into parts.

examples.text: Her clinic embraces <w>holism</w> by addressing both mental stress and physical health.
The company adopted <w>holism</w> in its management strategy to integrate every department smoothly.
